title: Spot the difference: garden
prompt: Three things changed between the two garden pictures. Which list names all three changes?
explanation: Compare the two pictures bit by bit: The orange changed colour from orange to plain, the green balloon changed colour from blue to green and the green pine tree vanished. Nothing else is different.
